response.justification: While Bogdan demonstrates exceptional technical depth and extensive software development experience across multiple domains, this role requires specialized leadership competencies that aren't evident in his resume. Critical gaps include: German language proficiency stated as 'Basic' versus the mandatory C1 requirement, minimal evidence of team leadership and mentoring despite senior titles, no demonstrated expertise in IT architecture design and UML modeling, and no background in security/compliance. He is better positioned as a senior technical individual contributor than as an executive-level technical leader.
strengths: Extensive cross-domain software development experience spanning 15+ years (web, mobile, embedded, real-time systems, GIS platforms)
Deep open-source technology expertise and passion (GISCollective founder, multiple open-source libraries, FOSS4G speaker, active community contributor)
Strong communication and teaching abilities demonstrated through technical workshops, courses, and conference talks
concerns: German language proficiency stated as 'Basic' but role requires C1 minimum—a critical and explicit requirement gap
Limited evidence of team leadership, mentoring, or people management experience despite senior/staff titles; resume shows primarily individual contributor trajectory
Missing key required competencies: no mention of UML expertise, IT architecture design methodology, security/compliance understanding, or requirements management experience
